says: Alice founds a Team and authors three Team sources: rules (Instructions), knowledge and a memory source. She publishes an edition that pins the rules and knowledge revisions exactly and states a memory policy - which memory source may be read, under which selector - rather than any memory record. The publish answers with the edition it stored, and that record is byte for byte the edition submitted: the same pins, the same memory policy, the same digest. After the Team adopts it, a preparation composed from the adoption applies the policy by fixing its own frontier of the named memory source at composition time, and its units are only the pinned rules and knowledge. The edition carries no memory record and the preparation takes none from it.
